question: Should imsg officially expose private-API arbitrary emoji tapback sending as a supported CLI and JSON-RPC capability?
rationale: The PR adds new user-facing flags and an advertised RPC capability backed by private Messages.framework APIs, so implementation correctness cannot establish whether maintainers want to support this contract long term.

options.title: Sponsor after compatibility repair
options.body: Accept the capability after preserving existing RPC aliases and adding focused upgrade-compatible coverage.

options.title: Keep classic tapbacks only
options.body: Decline the new public surface and retain the current six-kind bridge contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after compatibility repair
recommendation.body: Accept the capability after preserving existing RPC aliases and adding focused upgrade-compatible coverage.
